description:
## Features

### YouTube Music
- **Android Auto, covers in downloaded playlists:** The `Downloaded playlists` folder now shows covers in the car. Each playlist row uses the cover of its first track, and every track row shows its own cover. The covers come from the artwork saved inside your downloads, are cached in small versions, and are still there with no data. Tracks without embedded artwork keep a text-only row. The car app only gets read access to those exact images.
  - The `Downloaded playlists` row in Library now has a download icon like the other Library rows, also in the offline fallback. The icon is smaller than the other rows' icons.
  - Needs YouTube Music 9.15 or newer, like the rest of the Android Auto patch.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.27.0...v1.28.0)
